children: Longtime Microsoft executive Ryan Roslansky is leaving the company.

Roslansky was appointed chief executive of Microsoft-owned LinkedIn in 2020, according to his own profile on the social-networking site. Most recently, he oversaw LinkedIn and helped integrate Copilot into Microsoft Office as an executive vice president.
He will remain an adviser to Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella through the end of the calendar year. "Ryan leaves the organization in a strong position," Nadella said in a Thursday blog post.
Nadella said Dan Shapero will stay on as CEO of LinkedIn and Mohak Shroff will continue as president of platforms and digital work.
